zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.11** 让内置浏览器更好用：可以按角色名、可见文字或测试号点到元素，点之前会等目标真的能点。
切到别的会话再回来，最近打开的网页不再整页重载。
地址栏斜箭头可以把当前页送到系统浏览器。
源头选择分成「本机 / 远端」两栏，环境胶囊会显示当前 Worktree。
Qoder 队列会按上游节奏推进，并在界面上显示排队状态。
文档站 Changelog 已同步本版说明。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **按角色 / 文字 / 测试号定位**：`browser_click` / `browser_type` / `browser_hover` 可按 `role`/`name`、可见文字 `hasText`、`testid` 找唯一元素，不必再猜 CSS。
**同名元素用序号**：0 起 `nth` 点第几个同名角色、文字或测试号。
**点前等待可点**：动手前除了位置稳住，还会确认没被禁用、没被挡住、节点还在；超时仍不可点就失败并说明原因。
**切会话保活**：最近非空白会话最多保留 8 个活页，回来不整页重载。
**斜箭头打开系统浏览器**：当前 http(s) 页可送到外部浏览器。
**源头选择分栏**：本机分支和远端分支分开选。
**环境胶囊显示 Worktree**：当前隔离执行环境一眼能看见。

zh.title: 优化
items: Qoder 队列按上游节奏推进，并在界面上显示排队状态。
侧栏置顶会话更稳，流状态竞态已修。
Goal 中断不会被静默删掉；继续操作不再被门禁误拦。

zh.title: 修复
items: DeepSeek 和表单模式的模型目录走对通道，不再误走 Anthropic 面。
合回若因工作树已清理而停下，会对账结束，而不是一直卡住。
误提交的 `node_modules` 软链已去掉，避免检出时摧毁依赖目录。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本 GitHub Release 同时发布 CLI 归档，版本与 Desktop 相同。
一等产物：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.11** makes the in-app browser easier to drive: click, type, and hover can target unique roles, visible text, or test ids, and they wait until the target is actually actionable.
Switching chats and coming back no longer reloads recent pages from scratch.
The address-bar arrow can send the current page to the system browser.
The source picker splits local and remote branches; the env capsule shows the current Worktree.
Qoder queue follows upstream cadence and surfaces queue status in the UI.
The docs-site Changelog includes this release.

en.title: What's New
items: **Locate by role / text / test id**: `browser_click` / `browser_type` / `browser_hover` can find a unique element by `role`/`name`, visible `hasText`, or `testid` without guessing CSS.
**Nth among same-named matches**: 0-based `nth` picks which same-named role, text, or test id to use.
**Wait until actionable**: before clicking, typing, or hovering, wait for enabled, unoccluded, still-connected targets; time out with a reason instead of clicking anyway.
**Keep recent chats alive**: up to 8 recent non-blank session pages stay mounted across switches.
**Open in the system browser**: send the current http(s) page out through the address-bar arrow.
**Split source picker**: local and remote branches are separate tabs.
**Worktree on the env capsule**: the current isolated worktree is visible at a glance.

en.title: Improvements
items: Qoder queue honors upstream cadence and shows queue status in the UI.
Sidebar pinned chats are more stable; stream-state races are fixed.
Goal interrupts are no longer silently deleted; continue is not blocked by the gate.

en.title: Fixes
items: DeepSeek and form-mode model catalogs go through the declared plane instead of the Anthropic path.
Merge-back that stopped because the worktree was already cleaned can reconcile instead of staying stuck.
A mistaken `node_modules` symlink is removed so checkouts no longer destroy the dependency directory.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag / version as Desktop.
First-class assets: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; they **must stay in the same directory**).
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
